title: Insertion identity for Gowers cube points
statement: Let $n,k\in\mathbb N$, let $i\in\{0,\ldots,k\}$, and take $x,h\in\mathbb F_2^n$, vectors $y_0,\ldots,y_{k-1}\in\mathbb F_2^n$, a bit $b\in\mathbb F_2$, and $s=(s_0,\ldots,s_{k-1})\in\mathbb F_2^k$. If $h$ is inserted into the list $y$ and $b$ into $s$ at position $i$, then the resulting cube point equals the cube point formed from base point $x+bh$ and the original $y,s$; that is, both equal $x+\sum_{j<k}s_jy_j+b h$.
